# Wetland Survey Summary

This memo captures the first morning of sampling at Heron Marsh and highlights the stations with the highest nitrate readings.

### Sampling Stations

| Station | Depth (cm) | Nitrate (mg/L) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| North Inlet | 35 | 4.8 |
| Reed Bend | 22 | 6.1 |

#### Follow-up Notes

Reed Bend should be revisited after rainfall because the elevated reading may reflect overnight runoff rather than a persistent source.
